scenario: Sign-in page initial state
notes: Heading, labelled email/password, demo-account list; no password value rendered.

scenario: Sign-in page at mobile 360x800
notes: No horizontal overflow at 360px.

scenario: Empty sign-in submit shows validation
notes: Form-level alert is shown and focused; no per-field messages exist (observed gap).

scenario: Invalid credentials generic error
notes: Generic message, email preserved, no hint whether the account exists.

scenario: Borrower sign-in and role navigation
notes: Session storage saved; nav = Catalogue, My bookings, Incidents.

scenario: Owner sign-in and role navigation
notes: Owner sees Requests but not admin-only links.

scenario: Admin sign-in and role navigation
notes: Admin navigation includes Resources, Members and Audit.

scenario: Sign-out returns to public sign-in
notes: Redirect to /sign-in?signedOut=1, banner shown, navigation removed.

scenario: Protected routes redirect to sign-in with return path
notes: Both /bookings and /admin/users redirect with a next= return path.

scenario: Back navigation does not restore session
notes: Back button lands on sign-in; no protected content is re-rendered.

scenario: Rate limit after repeated failures
notes: Throwaway email only; 10 failures then HTTP 429 on the 11th attempt.

scenario: Borrower catalogue initial state
notes: 9 visible resources (archived item hidden), maintenance item visible, filters present.

scenario: Borrower catalogue at mobile 360x800
notes: No horizontal overflow at 360px.

scenario: Catalogue search match and no-match empty state
notes: Match view captured as screenshots/224-UI-BOR-02-search-match-d.png; the no-match state offers a recovery link.

scenario: Catalogue filters and pagination boundary
notes: Eligible-only view returned 5 of 9; single page, so pagination interactions are NOT RUN (no second page).

scenario: Resource detail content and request control
notes: Description, accessories, eligibility success, availability, passport link and form.

scenario: Ineligible borrower is blocked with reasons
notes: Dev has no group/training tags; plain-language reasons shown and submit disabled.

scenario: Maintenance bookable state and archived resource hidden
notes: Maintenance detail captured first (screenshots/229-UI-BOR-06-maintenance-detail-d.png); the archived resource renders the not-found page while the HTTP status stayed 200 (soft 404, finding F1).

scenario: Booking form validation then auto-approval
notes: Two field errors asserted; valid request auto-approved; booking id saved.

scenario: Overlapping request is rejected with conflict window
notes: 409 conflict surfaced with the conflicting window and waitlist guidance.

scenario: Join waitlist for a conflicting slot
notes: Waitlist booking created and its detail shows the WAITLISTED explanation.

scenario: Double submit does not create two bookings
notes: Two synchronous clicks on submit; only one booking row exists for the purpose.

scenario: Owner request queue with rank and usage
notes: Two competing pending requests, ranks, 30-day usage and eligibility shown.

scenario: Owner rejects a pending request with a reason
notes: Request disappeared from the queue; detail shows REJECTED plus the reason.

scenario: Second competing borrower requests the same slot
notes: Isha (7.0 h usage) joins the same slot as Sana (30.0 h), so rank 2 needs an override.

scenario: Approving rank 2 requires a written override
notes: Override error + required reason asserted; Sana approved; competing Isha auto-waitlisted.

scenario: Competing request is auto-waitlisted after approval
notes: Isha's request moved to WAITLISTED with the supersede explanation.

scenario: Cancelling an approved booking promotes the waitlist
notes: Ananya cancels; Rohan's waitlisted request is promoted to APPROVED automatically.

scenario: Owner records checkout and return; discrepancy opens incident
notes: Handover, MINOR_WEAR return, missing-plate evidence and the automatic MISSING_ITEM incident all asserted. Observed gap: the in-form success banners are unmounted by the refresh that follows submission, so the persistent status/evidence is the verification source.

scenario: Checkout before the 30-minute window shows a server error
notes: Tomorrow's booking cannot be checked out yet; no data written.

scenario: Borrower reports a manual incident from a booking
notes: Incident reuses the existing booking id and opens the new incident record.

scenario: Owner investigates and resolves the automatic incident
notes: OPEN → INVESTIGATING → RESOLVED with a resolution note.

scenario: Borrower sees incident read-only state
notes: Borrower sees the explanation and no status controls.

scenario: Borrower incident list shows involved incidents
notes: Both the automatic and the manual incident are visible to the involved borrower.

scenario: Owner passport shows full timeline
notes: Full audit/condition timeline; no restricted summary banner.

scenario: Borrower passport is limited to own history
notes: Summary banner shown; only Isha's own booking events, no condition/audit detail.

scenario: Admin sees every resource including hidden ones
notes: Archived and maintenance resources visible to admin only.

scenario: Admin creates a resource after duplicate tag rejection
notes: Duplicate tag rejected with a field error; valid tag creates the resource.

scenario: Admin moves the new resource to maintenance
notes: Status change succeeds and the resource page blocks booking.

scenario: Admin grants tags; borrower eligibility updates
notes: Tags grant access live; tags restored to the seeded empty state afterwards.

scenario: Suspend revokes the member session; reactivation restores access
notes: Suspension invalidated the live session; reactivation restored the account. Observed gap: the success message renders only inside the collapsed 'Manage access' form, so the badge/button change is the visible confirmation.

scenario: Audit trail filter by action
notes: Filter returns only booking.approved events.

scenario: Owner cannot open admin member management
notes: Server-side role guard redirects to /forbidden.

scenario: Borrower cannot open the owner request queue
notes: Borrower is redirected to the 403 page.

scenario: Borrower pages at 360x800
notes: No horizontal overflow on bookings, resource detail, incidents or booking detail.

scenario: Owner and admin pages at 360x800
notes: Queue, passport, booking detail and admin lists fit at 360px.

scenario: Catalogue, queue, detail and passport at 768x1024
notes: No horizontal overflow at 768px on the layout-sensitive screens.

scenario: Semantic landmarks, headings and control labels
notes: Checked 5 signed-in pages: one h1, labelled controls, main nav label, skip link. Issues: 0.

scenario: Skip link keyboard behaviour
notes: First Tab focuses the skip link; activating it puts the next Tab inside main.

scenario: Sign in using only the keyboard
notes: Reached fields with Tab, typed credentials, submitted with Enter; no mouse used.
